scope: Static visual concept package, exact proposed routing plan and research audit. No game-runtime implementation.
user_request: we need the conveyors that connect the machines to the storage house and to the other relevent machines and to the customer counter. It has to make sense too. Look at all the reference videos and do more research and find more videos and evidence.

deliverables.name: Transport modules
deliverables.views: Level straight, 90-degree corner and height adapter; useful opposing angles and visible transfer interfaces.

deliverables.name: Routing and finite buffers
deliverables.views: One-input two-output diverter; gated merge; normal and full receiving-buffer states; explicit direction and stop gates.

deliverables.name: Storage conveyor upgrade
deliverables.views: Existing house identity preserved; left utility and rear prepared-food paired IN/OUT cassettes; exterior and internal local tray/lift cutaways.

deliverables.name: Machine connections
deliverables.views: Shore intake output physically connects to cooker input through a new side adapter; cooker output connects to finite receiving buffer; meaningful overview and closeups. Timber/quarry attachment interfaces covered by route specification.

deliverables.name: Dual-input assembly connection
deliverables.views: New proposed assembler inspired by original A56–59s; separate ingredient magazines/ports, output port and visible wait-for-ingredient/output-full states. Recipe identities/ratios remain unfrozen.

deliverables.name: Customer restock connection
deliverables.views: Canonical timber counter; new staff-side stock-end buffer; clear register/customer sides; normal and full states and opposing view.

deliverables.name: Connected camp study
deliverables.views: Compact perimeter routing with storage, production, customer counter, centered heater and two clear gates; no external painted roads.

deliverables.name: Exact routing and interface specification
deliverables.views: Editable vector plan and machine-readable typed routing table, complete station disposition, proposed behavior, evidence matrix and source/proposal distinctions.

deliverables.name: Research and durable archive
deliverables.views: Inventory every registered source video and actual inspection coverage; additional primary-source videos; exact prompts, source hashes, original/repair images and independent reviews saved directly to GitHub.

requirements.text: All registered reference identities inventoried; every accessible source actually visually inspected at a declared level; unavailable full footage not claimed watched.
Additional first-party videos/documentation inspected and linked; distinguish game footage, ad presentation and real-world technical analogy.
Each route names item form, source/output, destination/input, transfer direction and evidence/proposal status.
Machine-to-machine, machine-to-storage and storage-to-customer routes are explicit; future assembly recipe remains provisional.
No universal mixed-food/fuel/material loop; each outlet/filter declares compatible catalogue; raw log/meat sales allowed only by explicit counter catalogue.
Storage original doors/apron, left window, rear vent and right fuel hatch preserved; low product sleeves are explicit new additions with local internal trays, not invisible routing.
Storage fuel, raw food, hides, cash/cargo remain explicitly manual in this first conveyor upgrade; no false full-storage automation claim.
Actual connection renders show supported surfaces, matched widths/heights, bridge plates/adapters and no intersecting legs or control access.
Finite buffers, blocked/full destinations, reject handling, reservation-based dispatch and prevention of store-in/store-out loops defined and illustrated.
Preserve canonical counter table/legs/shelf/register, staff controls, customer frontage; goods and cash separate.
Centered warmth furnace, two bidirectional gate approaches, storage entrance, staff paths and service clearance stay open; exact real-world scale/runtime fit not claimed.
Source style: sculpted rounded blue/orange/silver machinery, dark carry surfaces, warm timber; use inspected approved image inputs; no character redesign.
Separate critic inspects actual output multi-angle and use-state pixels, score at least 9.5 with every mandatory check passed; retain failed candidates and reviews.
Additive isolated art branch preserves baseline 4618 files and all originals; verified remote bodies/hash/path evidence; no runtime, workflow or main mutations.

milestones.name: Typed route design and critic preflight

approval_boundary: Art and research only; no costs/recipes/speeds/world dimensions/engine behavior finalized.
next_action: Complete new primary-source visual inspection; generate seven studies after independent plan preflight.
